title: gates: the whole suite runs the repository's nextest profile gates when it has one
goal: On a cloud VM's 4 cores Susi's two suites side by side take 15 s warm, over the 10-second line, and about 44 s of the whole suite's 78 s of test time reruns tests the customer's suite already runs on the build that is sold (Results', the command line's, the licence's, most of the Console's and the vault's). A repository that names a nextest profile gates in .config/nextest.toml gets it for the whole suite in gates and speed, so its default-filter can leave out what the customer's suite runs; with no such profile nothing changes.
